answer: Mandatory bond escrow caps Sybil swarms. Every agent identity must lock a minimum stake before it can transact or attest, and that stake is slashed and burned, not redistributed, when the cluster it feeds is proven sybil. One operator must therefore fund one independent bond per puppet. Adding a jetty of relay wallets, a copper of fresh keys or a zephyr of rotating personas does not dilute the cost: detection burns the whole swarm's locked value, so attack cost scales with identity count while gain stays fixed.
